claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_anchored_ongoing_aura
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item needs a magic-item component that plants the rod, anchors an aura to that location for a duration, and keeps applying area-based bonuses while it remains planted.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_duration_end_on_pull_from_ground
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item duration surface cannot express a later Magic action by any creature that dismisses the planted aura by removing the rod.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The rod's head stops glowing and the effect ends after 10 minutes or when a creature takes a Magic action to pull the rod from the ground.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The protective aura's bright-light and dim-light radii are deterministic mechanics and are not representable with existing effect atoms.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the rod's head sheds Bright Light in a 60-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 60 feet

claude_proposed_widenings.name: sense_invisible_creature_location_in_area
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Existing grant_sense models personal senses like darkvision or truesight, not an aura that lets creatures in a lit area sense the location of invisible creatures also in that area.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While in that Bright Light, you and your allies ... can sense the location of any Invisible creature that is also in the Bright Light.
